title: Employing Xe Plasma FIB for Fast and Precise Sample Preparation
content: Cryo-electron tomography is becoming increasingly accessible for a wide range of samples, from single cells to complex tissues, paving the way for new discoveries in structural biology. While focused ion beam (FIB) instruments utilizing Gallium ion sources are widely employed for high-resolution and precise milling, their slower processing speed can hinder throughput in large volume applications. Modern Xe-based plasma FIB offers a fast and comparably precise alternative for the demanding workflows.
